title: Quality Assurance, Operations Support Services & Service Delivery - Director
text:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title** Quality Assurance, Operations Support Services & Service Delivery

**Corporate Title** Director

**Location** Santa Ana, CA

**Overview**

*As a Director within Document Custody Operations, you will lead quality assurance, operations support services, and service delivery to strengthen execution, protect client and organizational interests, and improve service outcomes. You will oversee quality control, training, operational risk and controls, continuous improvement, and sustained regulatory, agency, investor, and audit readiness. As a senior operational representative and Document Custody and agency subject matter expert, you will translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into practical operating standards. You will partner across Operations, Client Services, control functions, Technology, and delivery partners to resolve complex issues and balance client service, efficiency, and custodial obligations.*

**What We Offer You**

* A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
* A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
* Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
* Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits
Educational resources, matching gift and volunteer programs 

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Document Custody quality assurance framework, operating standards, governance, and controls, including maker/checker reviews, segregation of duties, approvals, system validations, and evidence requirements
* Oversee independent, risk-based quality control testing, sampling, defect tracking, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, and remediation validation; report quality performance and emerging risks to senior leadership
* Lead training and knowledge-management governance, including agency and document fundamentals, competency assessments, certification standards, cross-training, and targeted retraining informed by quality findings and audit observations
* Translate Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC), Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA), private investor, client, and custodial requirements into procedures and service expectations; guide collateral documentation, certification, endorsements, assignments, allonges, trailing documents, releases, reinstatements, exceptions, and inventory controls
* Lead operational support and client service delivery, including implementations, service levels, capacity planning, complex research, incidents, aging items, and escalations; balance responsiveness with contractual commitments, controls, cost, and risk appetite
Maintain audit and examination readiness, oversee findings and management action plans, and partner with Technology on workflow, automation, data, and reporting enhancements that deliver measurable improvements in quality, capacity, client outcomes, and resilience 

**How You’ll Lead**

* Lead and develop direct reports and matrixed teams across quality assurance, quality control, training, audit support, operational support, service delivery, and process improvement, establishing clear decision rights, accountability, and development objectives
* Partner with Operations, Client Services, and clients as a senior advisor and escalation point, ensuring service commitments are executable, controlled, and aligned with custodial obligations
Influence senior leadership, Audit, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Technology, vendors, and offshore partners to challenge risk decisions constructively, resolve cross-functional issues, and deliver sustainable remediation and transformation 

**Skills You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Operations Management, Mortgage Banking, or a related discipline; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered where permitted by organizational policy
* Extensive experience in document custody, mortgage banking, loan servicing, securities services, collateral management, quality assurance, operational risk, service delivery, or another highly controlled financial-services environment
* Demonstrated experience with Quality Assurance/Quality Control frameworks, control testing, issue management, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, training governance, operational reporting, and client escalation management, including support for audits, client examinations, agency reviews, regulatory assessments, or formal control testing
* Knowledge of operational risk, controls, quality management, audit readiness, remediation, and service-delivery governance, with the ability to translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into operational standards
* Working proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience using dashboards, workflow tools, quality trackers, case-management systems, or operational reporting platforms
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs 

**Skills That Will Help You Excel**

* Direct working knowledge of Document Custody and FNMA, FHLMC, GNMA, private investor, collateral, certification, release, and exception requirements
* Experience leading managers, professionals, programs, or complex cross-functional operating models, with the ability to influence across functions, locations, vendors, and onshore/offshore teams
* Executive presence and effective written and verbal communication with clients, auditors, senior management, control functions, and technical subject matter experts
* Analytical judgment to identify patterns, quantify operational impacts, challenge assumptions, and make risk-informed decisions
Disciplined prioritization and follow-through when managing multiple critical issues, with timely escalation of material concerns 

**Expectations**

It is the Bank’s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the Santa Ana office in accordance with the Bank’s hybrid working model.

Deutsche Bank provides reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with a substantiated need based on disability and/or religion.

The salary range for this position in California is $133,000 to $203,500. Actual salaries may be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skill set, experience, education, work location and other qualifications. Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of remuneration.
